cover.headline: From the front door to the back deck
cover.house: Hardi Plank siding wraps this East End bungalow, with a new roof overhead and a new driveway along the side. The front door opens straight into the Living Room, and one wood-look floor carries through the Dining Area to the Kitchen with no thresholds. The Primary Bedroom sits at the back under a vaulted ceiling, and the Breakfast Nook beside the Kitchen has a door to the backyard. Under it all, the foundation was reworked, leveled and braced.

livingCap.title: Living Room
livingCap.body: A tall front window and a clerestory set high on the wall light the room, and the wide cased opening leads on to the Dining Area.

kitchen.title: Kitchen
kitchen.body: The Kitchen is laid out in an L, with marble-look counters and backsplash under white shaker-style uppers and over dark navy lower cabinets. The range, sink and dishwasher are stainless steel, and the pantry, 4' x 3', sits around the corner. A peninsula separates the room from the Dining Area, and a window brightens the sink wall.

small.title: Breakfast Bar
small.body: Two pendant lights hang over the peninsula, marking the line between the Kitchen and the Dining Area.

pair.title: Dining Area
pair.body: The middle of the open front, with the Living Room on one side and the Kitchen on the other. A sputnik-style fixture hangs overhead, and the hall to the bedrooms opens beside the peninsula.

pair.title: Breakfast Nook
pair.body: At the back of the house beside the Kitchen, with windows on two walls and a door to the backyard deck. The pantry is a few steps away, around the Kitchen corner.

wide.title: Front Entry
wide.body: Past the wood front door, one floor runs straight back to the Kitchen without a step or a strip between rooms. From the Dining Area the view reaches back through the cased opening to the front door, and the front of the house reads as one long room with a different job at each end.

feature.title: Primary Bedroom
feature.body: Away from the street, the Primary Bedroom takes the back of the house. A vaulted ceiling with an exposed painted beam rises over the room, windows on two walls bring in light, and a ceiling fan hangs overhead. Double doors open to the closet, and a doorway beside them leads to the bath. Bedrooms 2 and 3 are on the same hall, off the Dining Area.

baths.title: Primary Bath
baths.body: Double sinks set into a dark navy vanity, with an LED backlit mirror above. The walk-in shower is tiled in marble-look tile, with a glass door, a rain showerhead and a handheld.

baths.title: Hall Bath
baths.body: The tub has full-height marble-look tile, a pebble tile niche and a window above it. The bath serves Bedrooms 2 and 3 and guests, while the Primary has a bath of its own.

three.title: Primary Closet
three.body: Behind the double doors, a built-in shelving tower with hanging rods on both sides and shelves above, on the wall next to the bath doorway.

three.title: Bedroom 2
three.body: A front corner room with a window on each outside wall and a ceiling fan overhead, on the hall beside Bedroom 3, a few steps from the hall bath.

three.title: Bedroom 3
three.body: The closet is on the hall side, leaving the window wall free for a desk or a dresser; a fan hangs from the ceiling, and the hall bath is close by.

back.title: The yard and the East End

big.title: Open Patio and Covered Garage
big.body: An open concrete patio, 8' x 25', sits at the back of the lot beside the covered garage, 14' x 24', and a fence closes in the whole yard.
big.more: The glass doors open straight from the bedroom.

small.title: Front of the House
small.body: The board and batten gable and the covered porch face the street behind a lawn and a concrete walk.

small.title: Front Walk
small.body: A concrete walk and a gravel path lined with agave run from the street to the entry, under the overhang of the second floor, past drought-tolerant plantings.

back.closing: New wiring, a new breaker box and new plumbing serve the house, along with three-phase power, and the laundry is inside. A fence surrounds the whole backyard.

rooms.label: The living areas
rooms.body: The Dining Area sits between the Living Room and the Kitchen, with the nook at the back of the house.

rooms.label: The bedrooms
rooms.body: A hall off the Dining Area leads to every bedroom, and Bedrooms 2 and 3 share the hall bath.

rooms.label: Outdoors
rooms.body: The deck off the Breakfast Nook has steps that lead down to the backyard, a short walk from both the patio and the garage.

rooms.label: Fourth floor
rooms.body: The Flex Room opens straight to the terrace and has a bar and a bath of its own, on the top floor.
